program: Wingless RSI corrective tranche: calibration target-definition attribution
question: After R36 ruled out raw-composition locality, is the residual calibration failure caused by fitting BASE6 directly to heavy-tailed raw allocation advantage rather than a monotone robust target that preserves sign while compressing magnitude outliers?
hypothesis: R36 showed that choosing raw-composition-nearest training manifests worsened sign error while leaving MAE essentially unchanged. The remaining error may therefore come from objective mismatch rather than representation locality: raw advantage contains large held-out magnitudes that can dominate ridge calibration despite the operational decision depending strongly on sign. Freeze one attribution using the unchanged global three-manifest BASE6 fit and exact R30 exclusion set. RAW_ADVANTAGE_TARGET is byte-identical to the R36 GLOBAL3 baseline. SIGNED_LOG1P_TARGET changes only the training target to sign(y)*log1p(abs(y)); prediction is mapped back to raw scale as sign(p)*expm1(abs(p)) for MAE while sign is read directly from p. Features, examples, ridge lambda, manifests, exclusion logic, candidates, budget and held-out ordering remain unchanged.

predecessor.eliminated_hypothesis: raw-composition-nearest two-manifest locality improves the unchanged BASE6 calibration map
predecessor.strengthened_hypothesis: the calibration objective/target definition may be misaligned with the sign-sensitive allocation decision because raw magnitude is heavy-tailed

cause_effect_trace.observed_failure: R36 LOCAL2 increased sign-error rate from 0.5152 to 0.7879 and increased MAE from 10.7318 to 10.7813 on the exact 33 R30-excluded cases.
cause_effect_trace.exact_bounded_delta: training target transform only; BASE6 features, all-three-manifest training set, ridge lambda, candidates, budgets, exclusion rule, held-out ordering and capacity remain byte-identical
cause_effect_trace.raw_target_rule: y_raw = allocation actual advantage relative to equal allocation, byte-identical R36 GLOBAL3 target
cause_effect_trace.transformed_target_rule: y_log = sign(y_raw)*log1p(abs(y_raw)); zero maps to zero; no fitted or tuned transform parameter
cause_effect_trace.inverse_rule: for raw-scale MAE only, p_raw = sign(p_log)*expm1(abs(p_log)); sign-error uses sign(p_log) directly
cause_effect_trace.baseline_identity_rule: RAW_ADVANTAGE_TARGET must reproduce R36 GLOBAL3 predictions and aggregate metrics within 1e-9
cause_effect_trace.attribution_rule: support requires preregistered improvement in both sign-error and raw-scale MAE; no post-result target choice
cause_effect_trace.retain_revert: R37 cannot alter allocator behavior. Support authorizes only a separately preregistered target-aware correction or prospective replication.

frozen_reuse.exclusion_source: all three training manifests, byte-identical R30/R36 rule

classification_rules.mixed: valid AND SIGNED_LOG1P_TARGET improves both sign-error and raw-scale MAE versus RAW_ADVANTAGE_TARGET but misses one or both supported thresholds
classification_rules.negative: valid AND SIGNED_LOG1P_TARGET does not improve both sign-error and raw-scale MAE versus RAW_ADVANTAGE_TARGET
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, manifest identity, 1744 budget, exact R30 exclusion, BASE6 identity, global three-manifest training set, signed-log transform/inverse, ridge solver, held-out ordering, deterministic replay, capacity, provenance or accounting requirement fails

thresholds.provenance: same support thresholds as R36; frozen before R37 execution

rsi_success_note: R37 is target-definition attribution on already studied manifests; prospective disjoint validation remains required.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter manifests, BASE6, training-set scope, raw or signed-log target definitions, transform/inverse, R30 exclusion rule, thresholds, budgets/capacity, held-out ordering, classification or authority after primary output.
